validation.notes: Repaired three lifecycle fences and validated them across module boundaries with an executable regression that links the real production modules (harness/session/types.ts, values.ts, commit.ts, harness/execution/effect-gate.ts, harness/execution/tools.ts, harness/runtime/progress.ts, harness/runtime/drive/tool-placement.ts, harness/runtime/types.ts with the real Drive, harness/runtime/drive/tools.ts) through .prale-eval/subject.mjs#createGraph; only process boundaries are faked (validateToolArguments, SessionInvariantError, withAbortSignal/withoutAbortSignal) plus a serialized-mutation fake lane that records events/commits and serves reads from an in-memory value store. Fixes: (1) runtime/drive/tools.ts recoverToolInvocation now honours its cancelled flag, so a cancelled recovery only reads the durable checkpoint and publishes the interruption outcome with preserved content/details/usage - it never clears pi.pending.tool_output and never re-enters tool.execute; (2) harness/execution/tools.ts executeToolCall seals acceptingUpdates=false in the finally block, so live tool_update callbacks and {checkpoint:true} progress callbacks stop the moment the tool settles (success or throw) while in-flight updates are still forwarded verbatim; (3) harness/execution/effect-gate.ts beginAbort only transitions an open gate, so a closed gate keeps its terminal error for admit() and signal.reason and a late abort request cannot reopen it or replace the error; close() still wins over an in-flight abort. Non-regression covered: a live safe/safe recovery replays once with persisted args and memos, keeps tool details/usage on the staged result, and publishes exactly one tool_start/tool_end/message_start/message_end/entry_added; a live unsafe recovery still interrupts while keeping checkpoint details/usage; an aborting gate still refuses with AbortRequested(cancellation) and only signals after the durable cancellation. The script runs 8 scenario groups, exits 0 on the repaired tree, and each individually restored faulty baseline of the three repaired files is detected with an uncaught node:assert/strict assertion (effect-gate.ts: 'admit must keep refusing with the terminal gate error' received AbortRequested; execution/tools.ts: 'completion seals both live and checkpoint callbacks' 4 !== 2; runtime/drive/tools.ts: 'a cancelled recovery never crosses the tool effect boundary' 1 !== 0) - no crash, import error or timeout in any detection. Ordering is driven only by promises (an async toolContext commits the cancellation where the batch dispatch picks up live control); no real time, randomness or network is used. Limitation: the repository's own vitest suites (packages/agent/test/harness/**, e.g. execution-primitives, execution-tools, runtime/drive-tools, runtime/drive-reconcile) could not be executed because this checkout has no installed node_modules and dependencies must not be installed, so the executable cross-module regression is the validation evidence for this repair. Manual test scaffolding was confined to .prale-eval/ and removed after verification; no locks, Git configuration, TASK.md, subject.mjs or harness files were modified.
